title: The support of an integer multiplicity cone is invariant under positive dilations
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) that is integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity C) and a cone (IsConeCurrent C, η_{0,λ#}C = C for λ > 0): for every t > 0 and every x ∈ spt C, t·x ∈ spt C.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsConeCurrent C → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ C.support, t • x ∈ C.support
